question: Should CodexBar support and maintain ZoomMate as an opt-in enterprise AI-agent credit provider, including its private web-client cookie-to-token authentication flow?
rationale: The patch appears to implement the proposed feature coherently, but the linked proposal remains open because accepting this provider category and its endpoint-maintenance obligation is a maintainer product and security-boundary choice.

options.title: Sponsor the provider direction
options.body: Accept ZoomMate as an opt-in provider and proceed with normal final review of the credential boundary and large implementation.

options.title: Keep CodexBar coding-focused
options.body: Decline this provider category for core and close the proposal/PR with a clear scope explanation.

options.title: Request a narrower integration policy
options.body: Define a supported-provider or authentication policy first, then rebase this implementation to that approved boundary.

recommendation.title: Sponsor the provider direction
recommendation.body: Accept ZoomMate as an opt-in provider and proceed with normal final review of the credential boundary and large implementation.

likelyOwner.reason: Repository ownership and the linked unresolved proposal make this the clearest available product-direction routing candidate.
